step.cmd: Determine if a D13 and another disentitlement apply:

ul.li: If a D13 and another disentitlement apply, go to step 2.
If only a D13 applies, go to step 3.

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the D3 or other disentitlement as follows (if needed, refer to the applicable Out of Canada procedure for guidance on the details to include):

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — [enter the disentitlement code, e.g. D34) from XXXX to XXXX.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the out of Canada issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — out of Canada.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In FTS, determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed, go to step 5.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 12.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 6.
If all rows are blank, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next working day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 6.
If all rows are blank, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to clear the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, input the disentitlement on the Disentitlements section as follows (up to 4 disentitlements in BCS can be imposed, rescinded or terminated):

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .
Type: Select the appropriate disentitlement.
Start date: Enter the start date of the disentitlement.
End date: Enter the end date of the disentitlement or 9999 if the end date is indefinite.
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Click Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 11.
If the transaction shown is correct, click Close and go to step 14.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 9.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NISS.
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
Message: Select 3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim with the undeclared out of Canada.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
Earnings to be allocated: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 1: Type “D13 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”

Remarks line 2: Type the appropriate option:
If there is another disentitlement and an allowed period, type “D [3, 33, 34, 51 or 61] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X] and D59 [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
If there is another disentitlement but no allowed period, type “D [3, 33, 34, 51 or 61] from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
If there is no other disentitlement but there is an allowed period, type “D59 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
If none of the above applies, leave blank.
Remarks line 3: Type “ACS letter already sent.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-91-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Date claimant called or information sent (1542)
Decision reconsidered beyond 36 months (2595): Select Decision reconsidered beyond 36 months due to false representations

D13 or D38 Outside Canada (Interstate option) / on vacation within or outside Canada (2924):
D-13 Outside Canada / D-03 Possibly on vacation (option Interstate message)
We/We have reconsidered (2916)
Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485)
blank / according to our records / contrary to what you told us (2925)
Blank / Additionally, you were on vacation / Text: Indicate why was not available (2927)
Blank / Various explanations why certain amount of days allowed out of Canada (2932)
Various reasons for penalty and violation (2935): Select Blank .
No reply from claimant / reply received with an explanation / reply received with no explanation (2938)
False representation message / Number of omissions or false representations (2941): Select Blank .
Levels of misrepresentation (12292): Select Blank .
Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Blank .

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no resulting overpayment
Overpayment - No misrepresentation and active claim
Overpayment - No misrepresentation and inactive claim

step.cmd: In NIIS, from Report of Investigation , select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Disentitlement: Select Yes .
Reason: Select Outside Canada .
Penalty: Select No .
Warning: Select No .
Violation: Select No .
Select OK .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR WI for Investigation and Control.
